shortDescription: Set global configuration in AOS-CX devices

options.name: global_qos_trust_mode
options.description: Trust mode to be set as global for an AOS-CX device. Use "default" to set the factory-default global trust mode.

options.name: global_queue_profile
options.description: Queue Profile to set as the global one for an AOS-CX device. This option is mutually exclusive with the use_default_global_queue_profile option.

options.name: global_schedule_profile
options.description: Schedule Profile to set as the global one for an AOS-CX device. This option is mutually exclusive with the use_default_global_schedule_profile option.

options.name: use_default_global_queue_profile
options.description: Set the global queue profile for an AOS-CX device to its factory default global queue profile, this option is mutually exclusive with the global_queue_profile option.

options.name: use_default_global_schedule_profile
options.description: Set the global schedule profile for an AOS-CX device to its factory default global schedule profile, this option is mutually exclusive with the global_queue_profile option.
